decoding.note: Reasoning enabled both by the server and by per-request enable_thinking=true. Every request explicitly selects medium reasoning effort and deepseek-format reasoning extraction. max_tokens=-1 removes the prediction-count limit in this llama.cpp build, and the client has no socket timeout. Generation still ends naturally on EOS/stop or runtime/context constraints.

grading.canonical_text_correct: Normalized visible response exactly matches the canonical US-English rendering.
grading.instruction_compliant: Complete visible response contains only valid English-number syntax.
grading.numeric_correct: Complete visible response parses as number words and equals the integer sum.

pair_selection: Replicate 1 selected from each ordered digit-length cell of the established 30-per-cell frozen design; 169 total cases
prompt_template: What is {a} + {b}? Please write your answer in words. Do not include any other text or information, just the answer in words.
request_order: Easiest first: ascending maximum operand digits, minimum operand digits, carry count, longest carry chain, and result digits; the original seeded shuffled order is the final tie-breaker
